page.layout: One page, two columns of word list side by side, with a gathering signature at the lower right. The left column runs top to bottom, then the right column.
page.notes: The whole page is set in black letter, so no black-letter tags are used. The handwritten pencil or ink marks (beside "Boppen" and in the left margin) are not printed text and are left out. Stains, the ink dot near the lower centre and the faint show-through from the reverse side are also left out. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "Drittling" (first letter could be S), "Dallinger" (first letter could be S). "Bsaffot" and "Blappart" are read as printed, although the initial may be P. The signature "L 2" is read from the lower right and is uncertain.
